summary: Verified end-to-end the privacy/scope fix for GET /api/tasks (scope=mine|team) + the frontend 'Benim Görevlerim / Personel Görevleri' tabs + universal task sharing (Özellik Tanımla) menu. Backend pytest test_task_scope.py = 10/10 pass, regression test_task_sharing + test_tasks = 29/29 pass (serial, -n 0). Frontend UI verified for admin, manager, and employee.
critical_code_review_comments: TasksPanel.jsx is now ~2735 lines — the scope tabs / person-filter block adds meaningful complexity. Recommend extracting the tab bar + person-filter into a small subcomponent for readability.
list_tasks() uses `to_list(length=500)` — with heavy admin usage the team scope could hit this cap silently. Consider paginating or bumping the ceiling for admin.

scope query param has no explicit whitelist — any unknown value falls into the 'mine' branch by default. Not a security issue, just tighten to {mine,team} with a 400 on other values for API cleanliness.
seed_data_creation: Test tasks TEST_PRIVACY_ADMIN_ONLY and TEST_EMP_SHARE are created and deleted inside the same test class (no residue).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest MUST be run with `-n 0` (serial) and REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported. Login response returns `token` (not `access_token`) — the scope test file handles both. UI screenshots show: admin team-scope chips = TÜMÜ(39), EMP1_TEST(21), AHMET(15), MGR_TEST(3); mgr team chips = TÜMÜ(21), EMP1_TEST(21); admin mine defaults active with cyan highlight; 'Yeni Görev' button hidden in team scope; employee has no scope tabs but has 'Özellik Tanımla · Paylaş' in ⋮ context menu. Overdue-alert modal blocks initial clicks — dismiss with [data-testid=overdue-alert-close] before UI actions. localStorage token key: 'sertex_token_v1'.

detailed_verification.backend_scope_mine: admin/mgr/emp scope=mine responses contain ONLY tasks where user_id==self OR assignees.user_id==self OR shared_with[perms.view]==self. Verified per-row.
detailed_verification.backend_scope_team: admin team = all users except self (no self-owned rows). mgr team = only visible team (emp1_test) — verified by clientside owner-uniqueness check. emp team = [] as required.
detailed_verification.backend_privacy: TEST_PRIVACY_ADMIN_ONLY (owned by admin, no shares) is NOT visible to mgr_test or emp1_test in either mine or team scopes. ✓
detailed_verification.backend_response_shape: Every Task in the response includes user_id (verified in the Pydantic model + live API).
detailed_verification.backend_share_smoke: emp1_test creates task, PUT /tasks/{id}/shares with mgr_test recipient succeeds, task appears in mgr_test scope=mine list. ✓
detailed_verification.frontend_admin_tabs: [data-testid=task-scope-tabs] visible with 'BENİM GÖREVLERİM' + 'PERSONEL GÖREVLERİ'. Default 'mine' active (sertex-cyan/20 highlight class present).
detailed_verification.frontend_admin_team_chips: task-person-filter renders person-chip-all + person-chip-{uid} for each unique owner, each with count. Clicking a chip re-renders team-task-list.
detailed_verification.frontend_new_task_hidden_in_team: 'Yeni Görev' button not present in team scope. ✓
detailed_verification.frontend_manager: scope tabs visible; team owners == only emp1_test (no cross-company/admin leak). Mine list size matches backend (4).
detailed_verification.frontend_employee: task-scope-tabs NOT rendered (isTeamView=false). ctx-share item shows in task ⋮ menu and opens share-modal with share-user-search input. ✓
